name.value: Macaloney's Island Distillery and TWA Dogs Brewery

description.value: Macaloney's is Canada's most awarded craft distillery, producing award-winning single malt whiskies using traditional Scottish methods in hand-hammered Forsyth's copper pot stills. The same facility houses TWA Dogs Brewery, with craft beers brewed onsite including rotating seasonals. Touring cyclists can visit the tasting room to enjoy whisky flights, a pint of craft beer, or a behind-the-scenes distillery tour with the option to pour their own personalized whisky.
